text: The Patriots are heading into their Week 5 matchup against the Raiders significantly short-handed on the defensive back front, with starting cornerbacks Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) and Carlton Davis III (neck) ruled out, while the team made a flurry of roster moves Saturday by placing veteran wideout Mack Hollins and fullback Reggie Gilliam on injured reserve and signing cornerback Kindle Vildor to the 53-man roster alongside safety Brenden Schooler. On a brighter note, running back Rhamondre Stevenson has returned to practice after missing time, giving the offense at least one piece of good news heading into a showdown against a Raiders team riding the surprisingly torrid early-season play of quarterback Kirk Cousins. The Patriots will be without six players altogether on Sunday, though the squad is planning to celebrate the Pro Football Hall of Fame induction of kicker Adam Vinatieri during a halftime ceremony that will be streamed on Patriots.com. The team will also sport throwback uniforms for the contest, adding a nostalgic element to what figures to be a defensive challenge against Las Vegas's hot-shooting quarterback.
